Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it as Leo I the Great, Pope of Rome, in the Menologion of Basil II — the office this folder gives (Bishop of Rome), and the Menologion is a Byzantine liturgical book, so the figure is the saint as the Greek church keeps him.
